subject: [PATCH v3 2/5] mm: don't PTE-batch a swap-in of a folio with a hardware-poisoned page

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Expressed appreciation for the patch and added a Reviewed-by tag without raising any concerns or suggestions.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a bug in the large-folio batching path of the Linux kernel's memory management system, specifically when handling swap-in operations involving hardware-poisoned pages. The current implementation maps all pages of an anonymous folio without checking for poisoned pages, which can lead to unexpected behavior. This patch introduces a check to skip batching for anon folios containing hardware-poisoned pages and instead allows each page to take its own fault.
